description:
hentai2read.com title page (//, the page that lists a title's chapters) as served (OneUI/Bootstrap 3 admin theme, jQuery). There is NO

: the name is in a hidden div[itemscope itemtype=schema.org/Book].hide that holds only itemprop=name plus an AggregateRating, in og:title, and in the info block's h3.block-title link 'Morning Ledger Vhszmee [Doujinshi]' (the small badge is not part of the title). og:image is the site-wide noImage.png placeholder; the real cover is the img.img-responsive inside a (whose webp is .../cover/webp/_S86341.jpg.webp) in the 'Manga Info' div.block-content. Rows are ul.list-simple-mini > li > Label + a.tagButton links, with a malformed '
  • 試作たそてね
  • ' alt-title line first: Parody ('Quill Yfbg dj.' -> the series without ' dj.'), Ranking (plain text '5,812th, it has 2.3K monthly views' — not a page count), Status (Completed), Release Year ('-' placeholder in a javascript:void(0) link), Page ('52 pages' inside a javascript:void(0) link), Author and Artist (the same person under /hentai-list/author/ and /hentai-list/artist/), Category (mixes the rating 'Adult', the formats 'Doujinshi' and 'Serialized' with the genres 'Big Breasts' and 'Romance'), Content, Character, Language (English, javascript:void(0)). Parody, Category, Content AND Character links all point at /hentai-list/category//, so the URL path cannot tell a parody or a character from a tag — only the row label can. No concrete upload date anywhere: chapter rows say 'about 1 year ago' / 'about 2 years ago'. Noise: the left nav#sidebar with a 'Popular Tags' submenu of /hentai-list/category/ links, a 'Hentai Spotlight' slider ABOVE the info block with other titles' covers and data-mid ids (one is another Quill Eagq doujin), a hidden-xs ad, a right column 'Popular This Week' list whose items carry other authors (/hentai-list/author/), parodies and characters as /hentai-list/category/ links, a 'Latest Updates' list, a Storyline paragraph naming PenFpqu in prose, the chapter list (chapter links ///, data-cid, uploader '[Anonymous]'), a Disqus placeholder, footer. Unsure of: the exact Ranking wording and whether it is a link, the Release Year/Language link shape, whether characters really go to /hentai-list/category/ (they may have their own path), the author/artist slug format (lowercase_underscore vs Title%20Case), the 'Manga Info' caption element, the Spotlight/Popular/Latest sidebar markup and its position, the chapter row markup and the search form field names; the title, names, slug and ids are invented.
